Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-identity-outcome

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-identity-outcome defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
match-confirmed Match confirmedThe identity comparison confirmed a match under the applicable identity rule.
no-match No matchThe identity comparison did not confirm a match.
not-completed Not completedThe identity verification attempt was not completed.
source-unavailable Identity source unavailableThe identity source was unavailable: a source condition, not a request or match lifecycle state. Use only when the source condition is itself known; absence of a result alone does not establish source unavailability.
comparison-not-calibrated Comparison not calibratedThe source reports that applicable calibration is not established for the selected client comparison context. This does not establish match, no-match, source absence, or that a comparison was attempted or never occurred.
no-usable-face No usable faceThe reported client capture did not supply a usable face for the intended comparison. This does not establish a mismatch, absence of the person, or absence of every identity source.
not-attempted Not attemptedThe selected comparison is explicitly reported or independently established as not attempted. Absence of a reported result alone does not establish this outcome. Preserve whether the supporting status was reported or derived and its supported reason.
